jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.  

 

 

• Proven experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role with a focus on process improvement. 

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

Get started right away as a 2-shift Order Picker at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel and help us tackle the busy year-end rush! No two days are ever the same in this warehouse, where you'll be joining the team in the Lego department. Whether you're an experienced order picker or looking to kick-start your career in logistics, we'd love to hear from you.
 

 
 

Send your CV to talentcenter1@randstad.be, click 'apply', or call us directly on 011 54 92 85. 
 

 
 

VG 458/BUOSAP
 

 

Who are we looking for at Kuehne+Nagel?
 
 

• You have prior experience working with a warehouse handscanner, or you are highly motivated to learn order picking on the job. 

• You'll ease into your role in the 2-shift. 

• You speak and understand good Dutch or English to collaborate safely with colleagues and follow instructions smoothly. 

• Working a Saturday or Sunday shift during the busy moments is no problem for you. 

• You have your own transport to reach the site in Geel easily and on time.

• Using a handscanner, you navigate the warehouse to pick items accurately and on time from the shelves. 

• You ensure all goods are neatly and securely packaged, properly labeled, and ready for dispatch. 

• You are happy to roll up your sleeves for some heavier lifting and moving packed boxes. 

• You flexibly step in on Saturdays or Sundays to help cover the extra end-of-year rush (starting on the day shift, with a transition to 2 shifts over time).

Want to work as a night shift warehouse worker at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel for a gross hourly wage of €15.94? Now's your chance! During the busy period around Black Friday and Christmas, you'll play a vital role in getting all parcels ready for shipment on time. Using a hand scanner or pick list, you gather the correct items, then check the shipping labels and the quality of the goods. With an electric pallet truck (EPT), you efficiently move the prepared orders to the right spot in the warehouse. Every night, you'll step into a dynamic job where time flies and your effort truly counts.

• You can communicate fluently in Dutch OR English, ensuring you fully understand all safety rules and work instructions. 

• You have your own transport (such as a car or a scooter) to reach your workplace at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel on time.

jobs.occupation: PMO / Project Coordinator - Product & Technology Delivery
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced PMO / Project Coordinator to support the coordination, planning and governance of cross-functional product and technology initiatives within a large organization.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure effective roadmap execution, project monitoring, dependency management and reporting.
Key Responsibilities

• 
Coordinate activities across multiple projects, product lines and departments.

• 
Develop, maintain and monitor project and product roadmaps, milestones and implementation plans.

• 
Identify and track project dependencies, risks, critical paths and potential delays.

• 
Monitor project progress, delivery activities and go-live readiness.

• 
Support governance meetings, portfolio reviews and steering committees.

• 
Maintain action trackers, risk registers, decision logs and project documentation.

• 
Prepare dashboards, progress reports and management presentations.

• 
Ensure effective communication and alignment between business, product and technical teams.

• 
Identify opportunities to improve and automate reporting and coordination processes.

• 
Support continuous improvement initiatives across project governance and delivery.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience in IT, digital transformation or product-oriented organizations.

• 
Knowledge of portfolio management, product roadmaps and OKRs.

• 
Experience in regulated industries such as energy, banking or telecommunications.

• 
Understanding of application architecture and system dependencies.

• 
Experience with reporting automation, Power BI or AI-enabled tools.

• 
4-8 years of experience in PMO, Project Coordination, Program Coordination, Business Analysis, Product Operations or Delivery Coordination.

• 
Proven experience coordinating multiple projects, teams and stakeholders.

• 
Strong experience in roadmap tracking, project planning and implementation monitoring.

• 
Knowledge of risk management, dependency tracking and project governance.

• 
Experience preparing dashboards, management reports and project documentation.

• 
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

• 
Languages: English and French and/or Dutch.

You will join the Customer Service department of Biocartis, a Belgian molecular diagnostics company based in Mechelen. Our client develops innovative diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make faster, better-informed decisions for patients. Your work contributes directly to that mission.

Customer Service is a collaborative team. You work every day with colleagues from sales, logistics and other departments, in an international environment where customers and colleagues speak many languages. Short lines of communication, a fast pace and a shared focus on customer satisfaction define how the team works.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors
• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague
• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed
• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information
• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions
• Log and follow up on service requests
• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur
• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management
• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training
• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage
• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus
• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)
• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening
• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation
• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively
• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact
Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM
• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work
